name: Pricing tiers
summary: Plan cards with price, summary, features, and an action. One plan can carry the accent border.
accessibility: Plans are list items with an h3 each, so users can jump between plans by heading.
Check marks are decorative and aria-hidden; the feature text carries the meaning.
The highlighted plan is marked with text as well as color.

states.name: hover
states.description: The highlighted plan's action drops to 90% opacity; other actions fill with the canvas color.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A 2px outline in the focus color on each action.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: A 2px accent border and a mono label above the plan name.
